title: Simplehuman
description: About Simplehuman Simplehuman designs innovative tools that enhance efficiency in daily home tasks. Their product range includes high-performance trash cans, sensor pumps, mirrors, and kitchen accessories, all built to last and promote sustainable living. The company targets consumers who value quality and functionality in their home products. Simplehuman is committed to creating items they personally use and recommend to friends and family. As a result of a cyberattack on Simplehuman, more than 500 GB of confidential files and all of the company's databases were stolen.
